'''Beatrix C. Hiesmayr''' (born 1975){{r|born}} is an Austrian physicist who studies [[quantum mechanics]] and [[quantum information theory]] from a combination of theoretical and experimental points of view.{{r|2d}} She is a [[privatdozent]] at the [[University of Vienna]],{{r|ufind}} where she heads the Quantum Particle Workgroup.{{r|qpw}}

==Education and career==
Hiesmayr is originally from Vienna, and was a student in physics at the University of Vienna,{{r|2d}} completing her doctorate in 2002.{{r|why}}

Her postdoctoral studies have included positions at the [[Autonomous University of Barcelona]], [[Masaryk University]], [[Sofia University]], [[Slovak Academy of Sciences]], and [[University of Salzburg]].{{r|why}}

==Recognition==
Hiesmayr's doctoral dissertation won both the Bank Austria Award and the [[Victor Franz Hess Award]] of the [[Austrian Physical Society]].{{r|2d}}

She was elected to the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]] in 2019.{{r|easa}}
